task_summary: Full lncRNA arm for the psoriasis PP-vs-NN meta-analysis

steps.title: Fetch GENCODE biotypes
steps.description: Pull GENCODE/Ensembl gene biotypes and map to the 25,062 symbols in meta_de_PPvsNN_4study; classify lncRNA vs protein-coding vs other, resolving alias/legacy symbols so the count isn't limited to LINC*/-AS patterns.

steps.title: Build annotated meta-DE table
steps.description: Add biotype + lncRNA flag columns to the meta-DE table; recompute a lncRNA-restricted BH-FDR view; save annotated CSV.

steps.title: Rank and visualize
steps.description: Rank significant lncRNAs by effect size with k and I2 heterogeneity flags; produce a lncRNA volcano + top-hits figure using the project figure style.

steps.title: Rebuild per-sample logCPM
steps.description: From recount3, rebuild TMM-logCPM matrices for the 4 studies (SRP035988, SRP165679, SRP126422, SRP065812), harmonized to the meta gene space, for co-expression.

steps.title: Co-expression guilt-by-association
steps.description: Correlate top significant lncRNAs against STAT3, its isoform markers, and the IL-1/inflammasome + JAK-STAT gene sets within each study; meta-combine correlations; flag consistent partners.

steps.title: Curated lncRNA-target linkage
steps.description: Query curated lncRNA-target resources (LncTarD / RNAInter and literature via web_search) for documented STAT3 / IL-1 / JAK-STAT mechanisms of the top lncRNAs; build a linkage table separating correlational from curated evidence.

steps.title: Write lncRNA arm section
steps.description: Compose a written section mirroring the STAT3 isoform formal evaluation: methods, ranked table, co-expression + curated linkage, caveats (correlational, annotation lower bound, heterogeneity). Save as MD artifact alongside the tables and figure.

desired_outputs: Biotype-annotated meta-DE table with lncRNA flag (CSV)
Ranked significant-lncRNA table with heterogeneity/k flags (CSV)
lncRNA-to-STAT3/IL-1 linkage table via co-expression + curated DBs (CSV)
lncRNA arm written section mirroring STAT3 isoform work (MD)

feasibility.rationale: The meta-DE table already quantifies lncRNAs at symbol level, so annotation and ranking are straightforward. Pathway linkage relies on rebuilding per-sample logCPM from recount3 for co-expression, plus curated lncRNA-target databases; co-expression is correlational, so mechanistic STAT3 links are hypotheses, not proof.
